purpose: Prevent conformance rules, project governance, law, source quotations and editorial guidance from being conflated during future canon alignment.

CANON_CONFORMANCE.description: A rule/constraint defining conformance to the Pastafarian Calendar or its canonical semantic system.
CANON_CONFORMANCE.legalEffect: none implied merely by this classification

PROJECT_GOVERNANCE.description: A repository, branch, contribution, release, file-handling or workflow rule of the project.
PROJECT_GOVERNANCE.legalEffect: none implied merely by this classification

LEGAL_RULE.description: A claim about law, regulation, licence terms, legal rights, duties or prohibitions.
LEGAL_RULE.legalEffect: legal claim; requires appropriate legal source/scope

HISTORICAL_QUOTE.description: Exact quoted source text. Preserve wording; interpret its normative domain separately.
HISTORICAL_QUOTE.legalEffect: none inferred solely from normative verbs inside the quotation

EDITORIAL_GUIDANCE.description: Writing, terminology, UX or explanatory-style guidance.

examples.note: Exact Megillah quotation; surrounding explanation handles conformance/legal distinction.

examples.text: A conforming implementation must not swap calculation and target day.
Do not merge this branch into main.
This act is prohibited by statute X.
